notes: Corrected s009's target head from 'fiery' to 'serpent'. Rule 31's tie-break makes the ASV's bare 'serpent' for נָחָשׁ in this passage evidence that 'serpent' is the class noun realizing the lexeme, on the JOB.4.10-11 precedent; the accepted unit cited that same fact as a reason to head on the modifier, which inverts the rule. The competing reading (head on 'fiery', supported by שָׂרָף → bare 'fiery' at 21.6) is named in the unit's note under rule 8.
All other units stand: s007/s008 are rule 40's silenced dative with the suffix taking 'thee', and s017 carries the whole presentative frame with its complementizer under rules 21 and 45.
